portal_hypertension.title: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation: A multi-modal diagnostic approach.
portal_hypertension.authors: Shah S, Liu J, Tagkalidis P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：胰腺动静脉畸形极为罕见，文献报道的病例不到 200 例。 临床提示：尽管患者可能出现腹痛、胃肠道出血或门静脉高压，但通常无症状。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation is exceptionally rare with fewer than 200 cases reported in the literature. It is usually asymptomatic, although patients can present with abdominal pain, gastrointestinal bleeding, or portal hypertension. Their radiological features can closely mimic those of other hypervascular pancreatic lesions, particularly pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours, making accurate diagnosis challenging. We report the case of a 77-year-old patient with incidentally detected hypervascular pancreatic nodules and the importance of a multimodal approach in establishing the diagnosis of pancreatic arteriovenous malformation.

portal_hypertension.title: Imaging findings in Fontan-associated liver disease: Results of a single center study.
portal_hypertension.journal: International journal of cardiology. Congenital heart disease
portal_hypertension.authors: Lewis S, Mazurek R, Nemzow G
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：Fontan 相关性肝病 (FALD) 是 Fontan 循环的结果，可导致肝纤维化、肝硬化、门静脉高压和潜在的肝细胞癌 (HCC)，影像学检查对于评估至关重要。 临床提示：描述 FALD 患者肝脏形态和局灶性肝脏病变 (FLL) 的横截面成像特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Fontan-associated liver disease (FALD) is a consequence of Fontan circulation causing liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, portal hypertension, and potentially hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), with imaging essential to evaluation. To describe the cross-sectional imaging features of hepatic morphology and focal liver lesions (FLLs) in patients with FALD. This retrospective single-center study included patients post-Fontan procedure (10/2016-9/2022) who underwent CT or MRI and non-targeted liver biopsy for fibrosis staging.
